holder-quote: The Drake woman tsked. Weressna shook her head as Videl freed Rellmel.
Alrric was sitting next to Ilvriss, as a representative of his company. Vidam was sweating, but Nerul was merciless.
effect-quote: “Nine hundred thousand gold pieces. In your vaults tomorrow. What do you say, Wall Lord Rellmel? You have to know we can’t just walk off. And that’s…nine hundred thousand gold pieces now. Rather than ‘someday’. [Think About It].”
